//===== Ragnarok Offline ==========================================
//= Companion Recruiter
//===== Description: ==============================================
//= Hires out companions when Settings -> Population -> Companions is
//= "Hired from a recruiter" (population_engine_companion_hire: 2):
//= a companion of the player's own class tier, at their level, for
//= the fee set there. In any other mode every recruiter hides itself
//= at start-up, and the Companions panel drafts as before.
//=
//= The rules and the fee live in the engine (population_engine.cpp,
//= population_engine_companion_hire); this only asks and shows.
//=================================================================

-	script	Companion Recruiter::CompanionRecruiter	-1,{
	.@n$ = "[Companion Recruiter]";
	if (getbattleflag("population_engine_companion_hire") != 2) {
		mes .@n$;
		mes "I'm not hiring anyone out right now.";
		close;
	}
	.@jobs$ = companion_hire_jobs();
	if (.@jobs$ == "") {
		mes .@n$;
		mes "I have nobody of your standing on my books right now.";
		close;
	}
	.@count = explode(.@list$, .@jobs$, ":");
	.@fee = companion_hire_fee();
	.@item = getbattleflag("population_engine_companion_hire_item");
	.@amount = getbattleflag("population_engine_companion_hire_item_amount");
	.@cost$ = "";
	if (.@fee > 0)
		.@cost$ = F_InsertComma(.@fee) + " zeny";
	if (.@item > 0 && .@amount > 0)
		.@cost$ = .@cost$ + (.@cost$ != "" ? " and " : "") + .@amount + " " + getitemname(.@item);
	mes .@n$;
	mes "Looking for someone to travel with?";
	mes "I can find you a companion of your own standing, at your level.";
	if (.@cost$ != "")
		mes "My fee is " + .@cost$ + ".";
	next;
	.@menu$ = implode(.@list$, ":") + ":Never mind";
	.@i = select(.@menu$) - 1;
	if (.@i >= .@count) {
		mes .@n$;
		mes "Come back any time.";
		close;
	}
	mes .@n$;
	mes "A " + .@list$[.@i] + "? Let me see who's free...";
	close2;
	.@ok = companion_hire(.@list$[.@i]);
	end;

OnInit:
	if (getbattleflag("population_engine_companion_hire") != 2)
		disablenpc strnpcinfo(0);
	end;
}

// Beside each town's healer (npc/custom/healer.txt), two cells east.
